pullRequestDraft.head: codex/cloud-harness-continuity-2026-10-01
pullRequestDraft.title: Complete phase-one and phase-two harness continuity and preclass foundations
pullRequestDraft.body:
New Cloud sessions need a reliable route to project intent, confirmed user decisions and current source contracts. This change restores the phase-one learning/backend/Sheet source checkpoint and adds typed context routing, a safe managed-workspace entry bridge, dependency evidence, weekday/manual refresh rules and a synthetic revision-history SQLite adapter.

The preclass preview covers all scheduled students and records absence/makeup presentation. Student Knowledge Graph and Ontology requirements are checkpointed; hosted DB selection remains open. No scheduler, production DB or LMS writer is deployed. The recorded live Sheet operation only hid two approved Park auxiliary tabs, with metadata readback.

Validation: bun run cloud:check passed all three typechecks and 721 test executions, plus source-integrity verification. The complete 106-file publication diff passed the credential-pattern/protected-path guard and git diff --check. Live joins and native visual acceptance remain unverified.

resumeSequence: After user confirms installation permission update, recheck actual branch creation and git push; do not treat repository permission metadata as proof.
Fetch origin and verify main ancestry; preserve all local commits and dirty work. Never force push main.
Push the complete reviewed branch; verify remote SHA and file/tree parity.
Create or reuse the same head/base PR; attach it to this Codex task immediately.
Wait for CI on the exact PR head, inspect failures and fix before merge. Revalidate mergeability and unresolved review requirements.
Merge with expected head SHA using merge commit to retain phase-one/two commit ancestry; no bypass of branch protection.
Read back merged PR and remote main; verify source commits are ancestors and expected files retained.
Only after verified merge, fast-forward local main, switch to it and delete the merged feature branches; preserve unrelated branches, worktrees and caches.
